rules.statement: The Court has an inherent power to direct delivery of possession to the purchaser and render the sale effectual.
rules.supporting_quote: "I would set aside the order under appeal, and send the case back to the District Court for the purpose of the defendant being noticed to show cause, if he has any to show, why the appellant should not be put in possession of the property purchased. The Court must have inherent power to render that sale effectual."
